lines: Dil hi to hai na sang-o-khisht, dard se bhar na aaye kyun?
couplets.en: It is only a heart, neither stone nor brick, so why should it not fill with pain?

lines: Dard se bhar na aaye kyun?
Royenge hum hazaar baar, koi hamein sataaye kyun?
couplets.en: Why should the heart not fill with pain, and why torment us when we will weep a thousand times?

lines: Qaid-e-hayaat o band-e-gham, asl mein dono ek hain.
Maut se pehle aadmi gham se nijaat paaye kyun?
couplets.en: If life's prison and sorrow's chains are one, why should anyone find release before death?

lines: Dil hi to hai na sang-o-khisht, dard se bhar na aaye kyun?
Royenge hum hazaar baar, koi hamein sataaye kyun?
couplets.en: Why should a heart that is neither stone nor brick not fill with pain, and why torment us when we will weep a thousand times?

lines: Ghalib-e-khasta ke baghair, kaun se kaam band hain?
couplets.en: What comes to a standstill without poor Ghalib?

lines: Ghalib-e-khasta ke baghair, kaun se kaam band hain?
Roiye zaar zaar kya, kijiye haaye haaye kyun?
couplets.en: If nothing comes to a standstill without poor Ghalib, why weep so bitterly or lament at all?

lines: Dil hi to hai na sang-o-khisht, dard se bhar na aaye kyun?
